name: Ultrasonic Feedback Chain
_designNote: Feedback Microphone → Ultrasonic Weapon. Free cast, all lights explode dealing burn damage to enemies, removes enemy stealth, creates Darkened Ground per destroyed light.

name: Battery Overload Cascade
_designNote: Battery Spill → Overload Grid. If Conductive Ground exists, Overload spreads across entire arena. Light count multiplies arc damage. 4+ lights creates Blinding Flash.

name: Fractured Light Harvest
_designNote: Prism Mine → Solar Flare Step. If Ultrasonic Weapon shattered bulbs earlier creating Darkened Ground, each broken bulb counts as +1 Stored Lumen for delayed combo payoff.

name: Smoke & Spotlight Control
_designNote: Smoke Bomb → Tactical Spotlight. All non-spotlight tiles become Shadowed (enemies have 30% miss chance). Spotlight tile becomes Overexposed (enemies take +50% crit damage).

name: Feedback Loop Exploit
_designNote: Loop Recorder echoes Sonic tag. If Sonic tag played twice in sequence, next Sonic card is free and applies Overdrive (Sonic Ground duration +1). Can chain up to 3 times.

name: Vest Detonation
_designNote: Demolition Vest + Exploding Cufflink. Splash doubles from 3→6, creates FIRE ground. The ultimate disposable burst: 12 direct + 6 splash + fire ground + Expendable Ordnance combo (+4 damage + ammo refund). Total: 22 damage from one card play with the right loadout.

name: Recycled Assassination
_designNote: Recycler + Violin Wire. If Recycler saves the Wire: execute threshold rises 15%→20% next use AND applies bleed to ALL enemies (the wire whips around). Repeated saves keep raising threshold (cap 30%). The patient assassin's loop — keep the Wire alive, it gets deadlier.

name: Bandolier Barrage
_designNote: Bandolier + Chaff Flare. Guaranteed ammo refund (overrides 30% chance) + noise reduced by 2. Chaff Flare becomes: flee, noise +2 (instead of +4), ammo cost 0. The quiet escape artist's loadout.

name: Overclocked Flash
_designNote: Recycler + Camera Flash. If Recycler saves Camera Flash: Blind extends to 2 turns AND all enemies get Dazed (accuracy -10%). The flash bulb overheats but keeps working — gets more powerful with each save. Tourist weapon becomes spy weapon.
